description: This file defines an authentication service interface and a user data class for a Flutter app. It includes minimal scaffold implementation for authentication operations such as sign-in and sign-out, intended to be replaced with real FirebaseAuth logic later.

classes.name: AuthUser
classes.description: A data class representing an authenticated user, including uid, email, displayName, and photoUrl.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: An authentication service scaffold that manages user sign-in state using a StreamController. It currently performs no real authentication but provides the structure for future Firebase integration.

methods.name: authStateChanges
methods.description: Returns a stream that emits authentication state changes.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Getter for the current authenticated user, if any.

methods.name: signInWithGoogle
methods.description: Placeholder method for signing in with Google; currently does nothing.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs the user out by clearing current user and emitting null on the stream.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes the stream controller to clean up resources.
